name: Emotional Contagion
description: Catches and amplifies the emotions of whoever is nearby
behavioral_signature: Walks into a tense room and becomes tense, enters a happy space and lights up
under_stress: Overwhelmed by competing emotions from multiple sources
at_rest: Reflecting whatever ambient emotional state surrounds them
will_never: maintain independent emotional equilibrium in a crowd
unless: they've been trained to shield and are actively doing so
